subject: Food Science
title: What Is Food Made Of?
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: What Is Food Made Of?.

hook.text: Every bite you take is a mix of just six types of molecules. Food is chemistry you can taste.

buildup.text: Water, proteins, fats, carbohydrates, vitamins, and minerals—that's the toolkit nature uses.

discovery.text: A fresh apple is 86% water. A steak is 75% water. Even bread is 35% water. Food is wetter than you think.

twist.text: Remove the water and most foods weigh almost nothing. Drying is one of the oldest preservation methods.

climax.text: Understanding these six building blocks lets scientists design foods that taste, feel, and last better.

punchline.text: Six molecules. Infinite flavors. That's food chemistry.

quiz.question: What percentage of a fresh apple is water?
